body:
In the `test_allowed_database_copy_queries` test, it's necessary to explicitly close the pool because it copies a connection with the `dynamic_connection` alias. Due to this new alias, a new pool is created with the key `(dynamic_connection, user)` , and this pool is never closed because `new_connection._close()` only releases the connection back to the pool, but never closes the connection. As a result, when dropping the test user at the end of the test suite run, an error is raised because the test user is already connected due to this test.

In the case of `test_allowed_threaded_database_queries`, the alias is `default`, so it doesn't create a new pool; instead, it reuses the existing pool `(default, user)` and gets closed in the `_destroy_test_db()` call.

So if we delete this line, at the end of the test suite run, it will raise **cannot drop a user which is already connected** during the `_destroy_test_user()` call.
